definitions.gloss: shifting blame; passing responsibility onto others
definitions.explanation: Transferring one's own fault, responsibility, or burden to someone else who should not bear it.
Shifting a financial burden such as increased costs or taxes to another party, such as consumers or suppliers.

examples.japanese: {責任|せきにん}を{他人|たにん}に{転嫁|てんか}する。
examples.english: To shift the blame onto others.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{失敗|しっぱい}を{部下|ぶか}に{転嫁|てんか}するのは{卑怯|ひきょう}だ。
examples.english: Shifting your own failure onto a subordinate is cowardly.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}が{起|お}きるたびに{誰|だれ}かに{転嫁|てんか}しようとする{人|ひと}とは{一緒|いっしょ}に{働|はたら}きたくない。
examples.english: I don't want to work with someone who tries to pass the blame onto others every time a problem arises.

examples.japanese: コスト{増加|ぞうか}を{消費者|しょうひしゃ}に{転嫁|てんか}する。
examples.english: To pass the cost increase on to consumers.

examples.japanese: {原材料|げんざいりょう}の{値上|ねあ}がりを{価格|かかく}に{転嫁|てんか}せざるを{得|え}ない。
examples.english: We have no choice but to pass the rise in raw material costs onto our prices.

examples.japanese: {増税分|ぞうぜいぶん}を{商品|しょうひん}{価格|かかく}に{転嫁|てんか}できない{中小企業|ちゅうしょうきぎょう}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many small and medium enterprises are unable to pass the tax increase onto product prices.

notes:
Compound of {転|てん} (transfer) + {嫁|か} (to marry off, to shift to). Originally meant remarriage of a woman, but this usage is archaic. Modern usage focuses on shifting blame or costs.

Not to be confused with the homophones {天下|てんか} (the whole world; rule) or {添加|てんか} (addition of an ingredient).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {責任|せきにん}を{転嫁|てんか}する (shift blame)
- コストを{転嫁|てんか}する (pass on costs)
- {価格|かかく}に{転嫁|てんか}する (pass onto the price)
- {責任転嫁|せきにんてんか} (blame-shifting, used as a compound noun)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- なすりつける: to pin (blame) on someone (more colloquial, negative)
- {押|お}しつける: to force onto someone (broader usage, not limited to blame)
